title: nazm.test/1
description: One test case from `nazm test --json`. A case is `NAME.nz` beside `NAME.expected`; it runs interpreted and compiled, and both must produce the recorded output. One object per line on stdout.

expected.description: The contents of the `.expected` file, trimmed.

native.description: The compiled leg. `null` when `--interpret-only` was given.

output.description: Stdout and stderr combined and trimmed — a program's diagnostic is as much of its behaviour as its value.
